question: The famous Majuli island is located on which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Majuli is a large river island situated in the middle of the Brahmaputra River in Assam**__.

 
 
• Majuli is depicted as the** largest river island** in the world.
